$comment: sf-view-cards, standard simai.smart-component 1.4 (vocabulary 1.1.5): the cards layout of the view set (a gallery of record cards; owner decisions C297, C306). Study: ui-control control/research/2026-11-18-cards-view. The card is .sf-card, the cover the layout's own frame, the card fields the Framework field renderers' cell output, «Показать ещё» sf-pagination in its more look, empty states sf-empty-state, menus SF.menu.open, the selection bar sf-bulk-actions where the pair has it.

x-history.consumer: Nothing to change for a host. Repinned on the pair ui-b4f79e1c58b7: the provenance of the Framework helper field-renderers/index.js follows the pair (group build 17 F4, FS-9); the code and the markup are unchanged.

Nothing to change: the number follows the merge of view round 14 and view modular step 1 (a page that includes View bundles by hand adds smart/view-common/js/view-common.min.js before them, as modular step 1 says).

Nothing to change for a host. New settings keep-selection (marks of records not on screen stay; sf-view sets it, LV2-2) and all-selected (every record under the filter is marked: the cards draw marked, the bar says the total, an action asks scope all; LV2-7). The select event carries all while «Выбраны все N» holds. New setting bulk-bar (default true): false draws no bar of the cards; sf-view sets it and its own bar stands for the cards, so a switch from the table shows one bar (owner, 2026-11-22). New method selectAll(on). LV4-16: a field's label is its value's size (16 at size 1, 14 at 1/2).

Nothing to change for a page that loads the set through the SIMAI Framework Loader (the documented way): the rule relates to cl-view-common, which the Loader fetches first. A page that includes View bundles by hand adds smart/view-common/js/view-common.min.js before them.

Nothing to change for a host; card_labels: false still hides the labels. Card fields stand one per row, the label over the value, with a gap after the title (owner decision D3, 2026-11-21); card_labels is on by default.
Nothing to change for a host. A card without a cover centres its box and «⋯» on the title's first line (the «⋯» sat 6 px below it).
Nothing to change for a host. The rule fetches sf-bulk-actions (lazy, when the bar is first drawn) over the pair ui-b654460cad2a, which carries it; over an older pair the cards' own bar stays.

Nothing to change for a host. No field of a card is cut any more: the least card width is a step of the width ladder (S 224, M 288, L 352 px at a desktop, it was 192, 240, 320), so fewer columns are drawn, and a value that does not fit its place wraps at its spaces instead of ending in an ellipsis. On a phone the two S cards side by side show their fields one under the other.

Nothing to change. Inside sf-view, whose footer says «1–24 из 60», the cards no longer repeat the count under the grid: the «Показать ещё 24» button stays alone. Cards drawn without sf-view keep sf-pagination's line «Показано 24 из 60».

Nothing to change for a host: the release number of round/view-r4's 1.0.1 in view 1.9.0. 1.0.2 is the same VC-1 change on the superseded round/view-cards (never released), so the released number is above it.

Nothing to change. A number in the first «Кратко» column stays at the column's start; only the second column ends numbers, dates and files, as the accepted prototype does (VC-1, DEV's acceptance of the cards).
New: sf-view layout="cards" draws it, where the author turned cards on (C297); a host answers the window {page, per_page: 24} with {records, total, has_next}.

size.summary: The rung of the cards' text and controls.

card-size.summary: The card size over layouts.cards size: s, m, l = least card width 224, 288, 352 px at a desktop (--sf-measure-28, --sf-measure-36, --sf-measure-44, C396); the columns follow the width (C306). Empty: the options' size (m).

selectable.summary: Cards carry the selection box; Space marks a card, Shift+Space a range.

creatable.summary: An empty list offers «Создать» (the create event).

total.summary: How many records are under the filter (the host's total). Unset: the records shown.

has-next.summary: Whether a further page exists (the answer's has_next). Unset: total is larger than the records shown.

count-known.summary: false when the host does not count: «Показано N» without «из M».

records.summary: The records shown, in the view's order: every page asked so far (window {page, per_page}).

fields.summary: Field descriptors (sf-view's columns): the cover field, the title field and the card fields among them; the card fields are drawn by the Framework field renderers.

options.summary: layouts.cards of simai.view-config/1: cover_field (a file field or null; default the first image field), cover {fit: cover|contain, ratio: 1:1|4:3|3:4|16:9}, title_field, card_fields (up to four), card_labels, size s|m|l, density default|compact, more (button), per_page (24). No grouping (C297).

actions.summary: The host's actions on a selection (sf-view's bulk actions); also in a card's menu for that record.

keep-selection.summary: The marks of records not on screen stay (sf-view sets it: the marks hold across pages and display kinds, C295, C298; view round 14 LV2-2): selected may name records of other pages, and the bar counts every mark.

all-selected.summary: Every record under the filter is marked (the bar's «Выбрать все N», or «Выбраны все N» carried from the table, LV2-7): every card is drawn marked, the bar says the total, an action asks scope all; unmarking one card ends it.

bulk-bar.summary: Whether the cards draw their own selection bar. sf-view sets it false: the list's bar stands for the cards, so a switch from the table shows one bar, not two (owner, 2026-11-22; view round 14).

current.summary: The record open in the record card beside the list (C305): its card is marked.

empty-context.summary: Why the list is empty, as sf-view knows it: {kind: no-data|nothing-found|no-access|error, message?}; drawn by sf-empty-state.

open.summary: A press on a card, Enter, or «Открыть» in its menu (vocabulary open; trigger pointer|keyboard|menu|api): the host opens the record card (sf-view-properties beside the list, C305).

select.summary: The selection changed (vocabulary select); all is true while «Выбраны все N» holds the whole list under its filter and false once it ends (LV2-7, view round 14).

more.summary: «Показать ещё»: the host answers the next page; sf-view appends it (records), a bare host calls appendRecords.

menu.summary: A card's menu is about to open (right click, Shift+F10, «⋯»); cancel to draw the host's own.

apply.summary: A host action chosen on the selection (scope selection) or in a card's menu (scope record); scope all while every record under the filter is chosen.

reset.summary: «Сбросить фильтр» where nothing was found: the host clears the search and the filters.

append-records.summary: The host's next page (the answer to more), for a host without sf-view: appended, a record already shown is not repeated.

relations.name: cl-view-common
$comment: The View package core (view-common): the shared code every View bundle takes once (field renderers, formats, conditions, the filter window, and what two View components share), fetched before the component runs.

relations.name: cl-bulk-actions
$comment: The group actions bar (C295) where the pair has it: drawn while something is selected, fetched when first drawn.

relations.name: cl-icon
$comment: The cover of a record without a picture: the file type's icon or «Нет фото».

relations.name: cl-pagination
$comment: «Показать ещё 24» and «Показано 24 из 40»: sf-pagination in its more look (C167, C306).

relations.name: cl-empty-state
$comment: No records, nothing found, no access, a failed load (CD-8).

relations.name: cl-skeleton
$comment: Cards of the same lengths while the records come.

relations.name: cl-badge
$comment: Below: what the Framework field renderers draw in the «Кратко» place.

accessibility.x-keys: One Tab stop for the grid (CD-6, C146 (8)): the arrows go to the neighbour card, up and down to the card above or below as the rows are drawn, Home and End to the row's start and end (with Ctrl the first and the last card), PageUp and PageDown a screen; Enter opens the record; Space marks a card, Shift+Space a range; Shift+F10 or the context menu key opens the card menu; Escape clears the selection. A card's box and «⋯» take no Tab stop. Moves and selections are said in the cards' live region.

x-summary: The cards layout of the view set: records as cards in a grid whose columns follow its width, a cover the layout draws, a title and up to four fields in the «Кратко» place; «Показать ещё» appends the next page. sf-view layout="cards" draws it where the author turned it on.
x-decisions: shape: a leaf drawn by sf-view (layout cards, the layout registry) or by a host directly; it owns no data; shown only where the author turned cards on (C297).

reuse: .sf-card, sf-checkbox, sf-button(-icon), sf-icon, sf-pagination (more), sf-empty-state, sf-skeleton, SF.menu.open, the Framework field renderers' renderCellField; sf-bulk-actions where the pair has it. Nothing is copied.

cover: drawn by the layout in a frame of one ratio (cover crops by default, contain whole on a tint, C306 q-cover); the field template keeps its four places (C302); lazy pictures with width and height, alt empty (the title says it).
window: {page, per_page: 24} answered {records, total, has_next}; «Показать ещё» asks the next page and appends it (C306 q-window); no grouping (C297).

columns: auto-fill by the least card width of the size S, M, L (--sf-measure-28, -36, -44 = 224, 288, 352 px at a desktop, C396; C306 q-size); on a phone (the grid below 600 px) S two columns with the fields one under the other, M and L one (C306 q-phone); no card field is cut: it wraps at its spaces (R8-1).

$comment: The cards draw their grid of .sf-card with sf-checkbox, sf-button-icon and the Framework field renderers' cell output;
«Показать ещё» is sf-pagination (more), an empty list sf-empty-state; menus come later.

cover.const: file value {label, mime, href, width?, height?, thumb?: {<width>: href}}

untrusted_inputs: titles, field values and cover addresses (drawn as text, by the field renderers, or as an img src)

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-view-cards through sf-view layout="cards" for records a person recognises by a picture or a few fields (goods, media, people, projects), where the author of the list turned cards on.
do_not: Do not page or fetch in the element; answer sf-view-cards-more (sf-view does).
Do not use it for records grouped by a field (the board) or by a date (the calendar).

accessibility.focus: A list named by aria-label with the count (else «Карточки, N»); one Tab stop for the grid, the arrows by the rows as drawn; Enter opens, Space marks; a polite live region says the position, the selection and its clearing; after the record card closes focus returns to its card.

changes: New: the cards layout (owner decisions C297, C306): records as .sf-card in a grid whose columns follow its width (sizes S, M, L), a cover in a frame of one ratio drawn by the layout (cover or contain, lazy), the title in two lines and up to four fields in the «Кратко» place, «Показать ещё» over the window {page, per_page: 24}, one Tab stop with the arrows by rows, a selection for sf-bulk-actions, empty states by sf-empty-state.

DEV's acceptance return VC-1 (round/view-r4): fieldAlign(field, index) answers end only for a numeric field in the second column (odd index); the template passes the index and marks numbers data-numeric for tabular digits.

Release numbering (view 1.9.0): the same code as 1.0.1 of round/view-r4; 1.0.2 is the same VC-1 change on the superseded round/view-cards f85ac5a (not merged, not released), so the release takes 1.0.3.

View site round (round/view-site, view round 7 open item O1): renderMore draws sf-button (outline, primary, data-more, words more-text / more-plain-text in en and ru) instead of sf-pagination when the cards stand inside sf-view (context.inView); a click on [data-more] asks showMore(). Once the next page is drawn the focus goes back to the more button (or to the last card on the last page) instead of falling to the page.

R8-1 (round/view-r8): js/templates/default.css --sf-view-cards-min reads var(--sf-measure-28|36|44, var(--sf-f4|f8|g1)); the fields grid is minmax(min-content, 1fr) auto, the field and its values wrap (no nowrap, overflow or ellipsis); the phone S grid lays the fields in one column.
View round 9 (round/view-r9): rule.js and component.json relations name cl-bulk-actions (lazy), composition.uses smart.bulk-actions; the pair's field-renderers provenance hash.

View round 12, set 3 (DEV msg-c31ccebd, VHF-12): js/templates/default.css .sf-view-cards__top > .sf-view-cards__box, .sf-view-cards__menu take the title's line height (--sf-view-cards--title-line, text height 1/2 or 1 by size) and centre their control in it.

View round 13 (round/view-r13): js/cards.js cardLabels defaults to true; default.css fields one column, label over value, gaps by role (space-1/2 after the title, space-1/3 between fields); the two-column, end-aligned and phone S rules are gone; docs.md says it.

View modular step 1 (round/view-modular-1): takes its shared code (the Framework field renderers, formats, conditions and filter window, and what two View components share) from the package core smart/view-common once per page, instead of a copy in its own bundle; relation cl-view-common.
keep-selection and all-selected (LV2-2, LV2-7), select carries all, apply scope all; bulk-bar and selectAll(on): one bar under sf-view
LV4-16 label at the value's size
View round 15m: round/view-r14 and round/view-modular-1 joined into one line (merge, no rebase); the number is above both branches.
View round 17: repin on SIMAI Framework pair ui-b4f79e1c58b7 (ui-source e59dbad1c108, core.runtime 1.67.0); provenance of src/smart/field-renderers/index.js.
